title: Coverage Truth and Stop-Condition Engine
goal: Create a coverage truth engine that tells operators what is proven, what was tested, what is not tested, why additional checks are blocked, and whether the mission has reached a reasonable stop condition for the selected scope, ROE, depth, and evidence requirements.
scope: Assessment coverage, stop rules, report truth, and operator clarity.
generation_reason: The product must avoid false confidence and must know when to continue, wait for prerequisites, ask approval, or stop honestly.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Coverage truth must be derived from stored evidence, runner metadata, and policy state only.

success_criteria: Coverage output separates tested, partially tested, blocked, skipped, not applicable, and not tested surfaces.
Stop-condition output explains continue, wait, approval-needed, complete-with-gaps, and complete states with evidence and blocker IDs.
Reports and Mission Control can consume the same coverage truth payload without disagreeing about task counts or gaps.

acceptance_criteria: A full-chain fixture reports all chain tasks and honest gaps.
A blocked prerequisite fixture produces WAIT or complete-with-gaps rather than claiming full coverage.
Report catalog and API coverage payload agree on counts.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
